stem: 已知正方形 \(ABCD\) 的边长为1，当每个 \(\lambda _{i}(i=1,2,3,4,5,6)\) 取遍 \(\pm 1\) 时， \(|\lambda _{1}\overrightarrow{AB}+\lambda _{2}\overrightarrow{BC}+\lambda _{3}\overrightarrow{CD}+\lambda _{4}\overrightarrow{DA}+\lambda _{5}\overrightarrow{AC}+\lambda _{6}\overrightarrow{BD}|\) 的最小值是________；最大值是_______.
